report.summary: Patient P-D001 (58, dual Medicaid/Medicare coverage, ESRD on dialysis, T2DM, HTN) reports food insecurity: screener food_worry = sometimes_true, food_ran_out = never_true. Home tract 17031260300 is low-income with high area food insecurity (47.7%) and 27.7% no-vehicle households; patient relies on corner-store food and finds the grocery a bus ride away, especially draining after dialysis. Four local food resources identified; none have listed phone numbers in the directory, and eligibility is largely unrestricted (no ID, Cook County residency for Saturday pantry).

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Walk-in pantry open Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM. No ID required. Fresh produce available Wednesdays. Suitable given no-vehicle share and post-dialysis fatigue; consider combining with transit benefit.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM; take what you need. Low-barrier, no eligibility screening; good for same-day needs.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon. Cook County residents only. Verify residency at visit.

options.name: Harvest Table Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Local pantry listed in resource directory; hours/contact not published in directory. Call ahead to confirm eligibility and hours before referring.
